# contracts-before-clients

Define requests, responses, errors, permissions, and state transitions first. Clients consume the contract; they do not invent it.

**When:** Any API, data, or permission change with more than one consumer.

**Why:** Implied contracts force every interface to guess, especially under parallel agents.

**Do not:** Let UI state become the source of truth for authorization or durable rules.

Cite this principle by id when it changed a decision. Keep the citation specific.
